reasoning: Angular dark brown/black lesions bounded by leaf veins with prominent yellowish-green halos and water-soaked margins are the classic hallmarks of Bacterial Blight (Pseudomonas savastanoi pv. glycinea). The angular shape (restricted by veins), dark necrotic centers, and yellow-green halos distinguish this from Septoria brown spot (no halos, lower canopy), Bacterial Pustule (raised pustules, less angular), and Frogeye (circular lesions with reddish border).
